readers.deskkit: deskkit.IsHotfix / pin grammar (artifactTagPattern): `hotfix` only for vX.Y.Z+hotfix-<12 lowercase hex>; `pin` for a bare or artifact-prefixed release tag; anything else is neither, so a hotfix tag can never be written as a pin
readers.deskboard: staleState against pin v1.0.41 (unexpired): a valid hotfix over the pin is state `hotfix` (stale=false, HOTFIX: header); normalizeTag never strips `+hotfix-`, so every other suffix is drift
readers.deskboot: binary-pin's own-tag check against pin v1.0.41: deskboot is never a hotfix, so a hotfix-stamped deskboot is refused; the same release is pinned; anything else is a WARN (install lagging a re-pin)
readers.cellctl: versionString prints the stamped tag as-is, so a hotfix build reports its hotfix tag (never dev-<sha>); cellctl itself is never a hotfix target
readers.deskinstall: resolvePin's pin-tag grammar (anchored): only a bare vX.Y.Z is installable, so a hotfix tag can never reach a sha256-pinned download
readers.deskversion: umbrella inference from per-artifact pins (bareUmbrellaTag): only bare vX.Y.Z tags infer an umbrella; a hotfix tag is refused
readers.upgrade-assay: bareUmbrella target grammar: only bare vX.Y.Z is a resolvable upgrade target; a hotfix tag is refused
readers.statusgen: gateParseVersion accepts `+<build>` metadata and gates on the base, so a hotfix is gated exactly as its pin; `dev` and non-`v` tags stay latest (unchanged)
